summary: A loud full-colour classifieds page: orange banner with huge outlined slab caps, categories announced by a blue clip-art tile over a red-on-yellow label, eight narrow justified columns in Telugu and English, pink-tinted premium liners.

frame.masthead: Thin blue running head (page no., paper, date) above an orange banner backed with category names in small caps.
frame.footer: Bottom-right block of display ads: booking rates and a birthday greeting.

headers.notes: Extended black slab caps with white outline over orange, circular logo badge at left.
Blue duotone clip-art tile with its group name in blue outlined caps, then a yellow bar with the specific category in red heavy caps.

units.example: Om Swasthik White Ants & Woodborers Treatment...
units.notes: Advertiser name or first words in bold; Telugu and English mixed in one column; phone numbers with a ✆ glyph.

units.example: PRE- Owned Cars for Sale. BMW320D, AUDI A6...
units.notes: The paid upgrade: same liner on a pink fill, lead word in red.
Red/yellow/black, phone number set huge at the foot.

Times-like serif for English, Telugu serif alongside; very justified

notes: Columns are so narrow that justified English gets wide word gaps; worth reproducing deliberately.
